properties.Name: Federal Hill
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified neighborhood guide. Eastern boundary follows Key Highway and meets Riverside exactly at Cross Street; northern/western edges meet Otterbein and Sharp Leadenhall.

properties.Name: Federal Hill South
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified to the supplied neighborhood reference map and requested street limits; all areas stop at the north side of I-95. Not an official service boundary.

properties.Name: South Baltimore
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified neighborhood guide. South of West Fort Avenue, extends west to the Middle Branch shoreline, follows the waterfront around Swann Park, and follows the park’s southern edge east to South Hanover Street/MD-2. The southern extension lies west of Hanover; existing boundaries east of Hanover are preserved. Western shoreline is approximated by five straight segments, intentionally including some water and omitting small highway/park inlets.

properties.Name: Riverside
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified neighborhood guide. Includes the strip east of Federal Hill South to Key Highway and the mall north of Clemm Street, bounded east by the access road to East Fort Avenue. Shared corner at 39.2699664, -76.6018154. Southern boundary remains I-95.

properties.Name: Locust Point
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified neighborhood guide. The mall north of Clemm Street and west of the access road to East Fort Avenue is assigned to Riverside. Shared corner at 39.2699664, -76.6018154. Southern boundary follows I-95.

properties.Name: Sharp Leadenhall
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: Simplified neighborhood guide. Otterbein territory is excluded, with the northern edge sharing its Henrietta boundary. Extends south to West Ostend Street, retaining the boundary with South Baltimore along Race Street.

properties.Name: Otterbein
properties.source: User-directed neighborhood outlines aligned to OpenStreetMap streets
properties.note: User-requested approximate boundary: south of West Conway, east of Cal Ripken Way, west of Light; north of Hughes east of Hanover and Henrietta west of Hanover. Its southern edge now meets Sharp Leadenhall without overlap. Eastern edge is a straight line inset west of the highway, meeting Federal Hill at the southern corner.
